content.stem: 一家人寿保险公司的反洗钱报告官(MLRO)正在审查产品风险评估方法.以下哪些人寿保险产品的属性会被赋予较高的风险评级？(选择三项.)

options.A: 允许大额不规则缴费并具有资金积累功能的年金产品
options.B: 允许在保单生效后变更指定受益人的产品
options.C: 具有国际健康保险保障的产品
options.D: 允许有现金退保价值的产品
options.E: 限制资金从一份保单转移到另一份保单的产品

content.stem_en: The money laundering reporting officer (MLRO) of a life insurance company is reviewing the product risk assessment methodology. Which of the following attributes of life insurance products would be attributed a higher risk rating? (Select three.)

options_en.A: Annuity products that allow large, irregular premium payments and accumulation of value
options_en.B: Products that allow the option to change the nominated beneficiary after the commencement of the policy
options_en.C: Products with international health insurance coverage
options_en.D: Products that allow for a cash surrender value
options_en.E: Products that restrict the transfer of funds from one policy to another
